name: seamlex-portal
description: Customer-facing front door to Seamlex, your Salesforce delivery partner. Run the relevamientos of your sprint with the Product Owner into a GitHub minuta file and its pending sub-tasks, following the Seamlex house rules for Jira and GitHub. Everything lands in the shared Jira project via the bundled Atlassian MCP server, and your GitHub documentation repo via a GitHub MCP server you connect yourself.
